$comment: Manual matches of country-level units of the CURRENT unit source (GADM today; children of the continent roots) to canon country slugs. Optional rootName disambiguates duplicate names (Antarctic claims). Matching-only — never membership. Filled during calibration (Task 9). Every entry cites the observed mis-match it corrects; bbox evidence in .superpowers/sdd/task-9-report.md.

overrides.reason: Geometric share < 0.5: NE 10m draws the atolls as simplified specks that barely intersect GADM's Maldives land polygons (unit went unmatched in calibration runs). Unambiguous 1:1 with ISO MV/MDV; NE feature 'Maldives' (MDV, Sovereign country) exists.

ISO-key mismatch, not geometry: NE Kosovo carries ADM0_A3=KOS (ISO_A3=-99) while Wikidata/canon iso3 is XKS, so the NE feature never enters the iso3-keyed matching pool and the unit stays unmatched. Canon entry xk (Q1246) is the same polity.

Both NE 'Morocco' (MAR) and NE 'Western Sahara' (ESH, type Indeterminate) polygons cover this unit with near-1.0 shares; the geometric winner is share-noise/row-order dependent (landed 'ma' in both calibration runs). Spec (country-canon-and-disputes.md, resolution semantics) requires the neutral base record for disputed ground — the Western Sahara entry itself (eh); the w-sahara attribution dispute overlays the user-facing choice.

NE 10m does not carve the Vatican enclave out of Italy, so the unit matched 'it' geometrically in calibration runs. The Holy See is a UN-observer canon record (va) and must own its unit; otherwise visits to it count as Italy.

Unit is Christmas Island + Cocos (Keeling) Islands (bbox 96.8..105.7 E, -12.2..-10.4). NE keys the covering feature 'Indian Ocean Territories' as ISO_A3_EH=AUS, which collides with mainland Australia in the slug-keyed temp table and is dropped. The unit aggregates two ISO territories (cx, cc), so the only single canon record covering the whole unit is their sovereign, au.

NE feature 'Ashmore and Cartier Islands' is keyed ISO_A3_EH=AUS (ADM0_A3=ATC) and lost to the mainland-Australia slug-key collision, leaving the unit unmatched. Australian external territory with no own ISO 3166-1 code — au is the correct record.
Same as Ashmore and Cartier: NE 'Coral Sea Islands' keyed ISO_A3_EH=AUS (ADM0_A3=CSI), dropped by the slug-key collision. Australian external territory without own ISO code.

Unit is Brazil's oceanic islands placed under the Africa root by GADM (bbox -40.4..-28.8, -20.5..-20.2: Trindade & Martim Vaz; unmatched in calibration). NE 10m Brazil omits/simplifies these specks, so no geometric overlap. Brazilian federal territory.
Unit is Cocos Island (bbox -87.1, 5.5), Costa Rica's Pacific territory placed under the South America root. NE 10m Costa Rica polygon does not reach the speck, so the unit went unmatched.

Unit is the San Andres y Providencia archipelago (bbox -81.8..-78.6, 12.2..15.9), a Colombian department placed under the North America root. NE 10m islands are too small/offset for a 0.5 share, so the unit went unmatched.

Unit is Bouvet Island (bbox 3.3..3.5 E, -54.5..-54.4), not an Antarctic claim sector. Geometry matched 'no' (NE polygon packing), but ISO 3166-1 and the project's no-rollup travel-identity convention model Bouvet as the separate territory bv (BVT); the mainland-Norway record must not absorb it.
